newsitem.title: FINLAND: BALTIC ICE - Ice emerges in northern Gulf of Bothnia.
newsitem.headline: BALTIC ICE - Ice emerges in northern Gulf of Bothnia.

text.p: Ice has emerged in bays at the far northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, above 65 degrees north, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Thursday.
About five centimetres of fast ice has accummulated off the Finnish port of Kemi, it said in its bi-weekly report.
Ports further south were still clear, with water temperatures ranging from one to six degrees Celsius in the Gulf of Bothnia and from four to seven degrees in the Gulf of Finland, the institute said.
(NOTE: Fast ice - level, flat, not moving.)
